About This Job
Netcompany is looking for data-focused professionals with at least two years’ experience supporting production database environments to join our team on a permanent basis. You will take ownership of your work and contribute to keeping database services secure, reliable and resilient, while developing your skills on complex client projects.
Key Responsibilities
• Support and maintain production databases, investigating incidents and resolving service issues.
• Monitor database health, availability and performance, identifying opportunities for improvement.
• Perform and validate database backups and restores, and support disaster recovery arrangements.
• Manage database access and implement changes through agreed security and change control processes.
• Maintain clear operational documentation and share knowledge with colleagues.
Essential
• At least two years’ experience supporting production systems, including hands-on experience with relational databases in an administration, development or operations role.
• An enthusiasm for data and a commitment to learning and developing new skills.
• A logical, proactive approach, with the ability to take ownership of work and recognise when to seek support.
• Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to a range of audiences and share knowledge with colleagues.
• Demonstrable problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, including identifying root causes and resolving database issues to maintain availability and efficient performance, supported by practical skills in query optimisation, index design and maintenance, and execution plan analysis.
• Demonstrable understanding of database schemas and design principles, including tables, relationships, keys, constraints and indexes.
• Demonstrable understanding of database high availability and disaster recovery approaches.
• Hands-on experience implementing database backup strategies, restoring databases and validating successful recovery, supported by a demonstrable understanding of recovery models.
• Familiarity with data migration approaches and tools, including extract, transform and load (ETL) processes.
• Demonstrable understanding of database access controls and the principle of least privilege.
• Ability to write and maintain reliable SQL and administrative scripts, and apply production changes safely through impact assessment, testing and rollback planning.
• Experience using monitoring tools to assess database health, availability and performance, investigate alerts and take appropriate action.
• Eligibility to obtain the security clearance required for the role.

Qualifications
Desirable
• Experience testing database code or administrative scripts, including unit testing where appropriate.
• Understanding of ITIL fundamentals, particularly incident, problem and change management.
• Experience working with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS.
• Experience supporting wider IT infrastructure.

Additional Information
Netcompany Academy
Through our Netcompany Academy, we offer a diverse range of courses, seminars and certifications carefully curated to support your development. As you advance in your career, the Academy tailors its offerings to enhance your managerial skills, deepen your understanding of methodologies, hone your leadership abilities, and fine-tune your strategic acumen.
As you progress through the content, you’ll naturally take on more responsibility and network with your peers.
Benefits include
• 25 days’ holiday
• Private Medical Health care via Vitality
• Pension contribution, Life Assurance
• Professional certifications supported as part of learning and development.
• A range of retail discounts to enhance your lifestyle, encompassing restaurants, supermarkets, travel, leisure activities and health and well-being services.
• Access to our Employee Resource Groups, our groups represent diverse backgrounds and provide a platform for colleagues to connect, learn, and support one another.
Company information
At Netcompany, we pride ourselves on our entrepreneurial spirit and our capacity for doing things differently. Our culture is built on fostering low bureaucracy, emphasizing high agility and promoting flexibility, enabling everyone to contribute their best.
Our journey began in the UK with the acquisition of Hunter Macdonald in 2017. As one of Northern Europe's most accomplished IT companies, we have expanded our headcount globally to 7400+ employees and have offices in UK, Denmark, Norway, Poland, Holland and Vietnam.
Netcompany is committed to providing an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment process for anyone wishing to apply for a job with us. We operate a Disability Confident Interview Scheme which means that we offer guaranteed interviews to all applicants with a disability who meet the minimum criteria for a role. Applicants are asked to opt in, so please let us know if you wish your application to be considered under this scheme.
If you need any reasonable adjustments or extra support during the recruitment process, please contact us at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com.

About This Job
Are you an experienced Control & Instrumentation Engineer looking to work on some of the most advanced and complex engineering challenges in the UK?
The salary for this role is £64,820 (inclusive of a Specialist Allowance).
This role is based at the following site: Culham, Oxfordshire
The Role
The Control & Instrumentation Group provides organisation-wide expertise, support and services for UKAEA projects, with strong capability in the design, delivery, installation and commissioning of electrical, control and instrumentation systems. Our work underpins major operational facilities today while helping shape future fusion technologies.
As Senior Control & Instrumentation Engineer, you will provide and apply key technical skills related to Control and Instrumentation systems to enable the successful delivery of projects and programmes across UKAEA.
The role holder will act as a subject matter expert in control and instrumentation, leading and owning large, high-risk work packages involving complex systems and technical studies.
Key Accountabilities:
•
Lead medium-to-large scale fusion C&I projects from concept through to detailed design for facility upgrades and future technologies.
•
Act as Subject Matter Expert for control and instrumentation systems across projects and programmes.
•
Produce or contribute to technical decision papers, involving innovative problem solving of novel situations, analysing unprecedent technical issues and influencing strategic project direction and approaches.
•
Develop control system architectures and solutions, specifications, and documentation, applying innovative solutions to complex technical challenges.
•
Provide technical leadership for control and safety systems, covering architecture design, software development, installation, commissioning, and lifecycle management.
•
Lead and deliver software development using industrial control platforms (e.g. Siemens S7/PCS7, LabVIEW, ABB 800xA, Python, C++).
• Manage project delivery, including requirements capture, design reviews, HAZOPs, risk management, budgets, and stakeholder engagement.
• Coordinate and mentor multidisciplinary teams and contractors, ensuring safe, high-quality, and cost-effective delivery in line with organisational and regulatory standards.
This role is primarily onsite due to the nature of the work and the facilities involved. However, hybrid working can be discussed where possible, depending on business needs.

Qualifications
Essential:
•
A degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering or equivalent, and relevant professional experience in an engineering role. Or a minimum of a HND in Electrical/Electronic discipline, or equivalent qualification level, with a greater breadth and depth of experience/knowledge.
•
Excellent knowledge and significant experience of PLC and SCADA systems
• Demonstrable experience with Siemens, ABB 800Xa or similar control system applications.
• Deep understanding of EC&I documents (SLDs, P&IDs, C&Es, schematics etc.)
• Advanced knowledge and understanding of safe working practices and procedures, with substantial experience of preparing safety documentation (i.e. risk assessments, method statements, permits, isolations etc).
•
Demonstrable experience in design, installation and testing of Control and Instrumentation software and hardware systems.
•
Identify policy/process improvements in C&I engineering and contribute to proposals that influence organisational standards and governance.
• Experience working in a scientific / engineering environment following strict safety processes, collaborating with a broad variety of stakeholders
This role requires employees to complete an online Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS), including The Disclosure & Barring Service (DBS) checks for criminal convictions and possibly a search of open source data.

Additional Information
A full list of our benefits can be found here https://careers.ukaea.uk/life-at-ukaea/employee-benefits/

We’re looking for a Lead Data Scientist (IC3) to join our Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Handling & Prevent team in London.
This role is a unique opportunity to work on the intelligence system at the core of our operational handling and prevention work. You'll help automate components of our operational systems, establish robust LLM evaluation pipelines, and build solutions that reduce financial crime risk. What you build will have a direct impact on Wise’s mission and millions of our customers.
The AML Handling & Prevent team offers an exciting environment for applying cutting-edge Generative AI solutions and machine learning architectures. This team is dedicated to enhancing our financial crime mitigation operations through advanced tooling, automated evaluation frameworks, and prompt optimization, aiming to streamline reviews and simplify the work of our operations staff. As a Lead Data Scientist (IC3), you will drive technical strategy across handling and prevent initiatives, architect robust AI systems, establish post-deployment monitoring, and lead complex automation initiatives to reduce financial crime risk across Wise.
Here’s how you’ll be contributing:
•
End-to-End Automation & EDD LLMs: Lead the development and deployment of AI models designed to augment operational workflows (e.g. Business and Consumer EDD LLMs), specifically targeting the automation of case summaries, red flag generation, risk classifications, and document requests.
•
Evaluation Framework & Labeling Taxonomy: Establish labeling taxonomies and guidelines with EDD SMEs, construct evaluation datasets, and implement automated eval harnesses to systematically measure accuracy, precision, recall, and failure modes.
•
Prompt Optimization & Experimentation: Audit existing prompts and run structured experiments (few-shot, chain-of-thought, context ordering) within a hypothesis-driven testing framework to reduce hallucinations, formatting errors, and prompt drift.
•
Shadow Testing & Monitoring: Design shadow mode deployments and parallel execution testing to safely evaluate prompts at scale, while implementing post-deployment monitoring for data and output drift.
•
Full-Stack Deployment: Take ownership of the production pipeline by writing and deploying production-ready Python services. You must be willing to bypass engineering bottlenecks to ship value quickly while maintaining code quality.
•
Human-in-the-Loop Architecture: Design systems where AI provides recommendations and drafts, ensuring human operators retain the final decision-making authority for critical financial crime mitigation assessments.
•
Strategic Demand Deflection: Go beyond ticket handling by analyzing upstream data to create strategies that deflect financial crime attempts before they reach the operations team, effectively reducing manual workload.
•
Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Set technical direction, mentor Senior and Junior Data Scientists, foster a product-focused mindset, and guide the team through complex technical implementations, architectural decisions, and AI governance standards.
A bit about you:
•
Experience implementing, training, testing and evaluating performance of Machine Learning systems;
•
Strong Python knowledge. A big plus for proven familiarity and experience with OOP principles;
•
Knowledge and experience developing and evaluating GenAI / LLM solutions, including automated eval harnesses and prompt engineering;

Experience with statistical analysis, experiment design, and failure mode analysis in LLM systems;
•
A strong product mindset with the ability to work independently in a cross-functional and cross-team environment;
•
Good communication skills and ability to get the point across to non-technical individuals and SMEs;

Strong problem solving skills with the ability to help refine problem statements and figure out how to solve them.

Familiarity with automating operational processes via technical solutions, for example Large Language Models

Familiarity with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph or similar.

Working knowledge of Java.

The Regulatory Reporting Accountant is responsible for the timely and accurate preparation of regulatory returns to the Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA), Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and Bank of England (BoE). The role
We have established a market-leading Legal Project Management team. Those who join our award-winning team become integral to shaping a rapidly evolving area of law essential to the firm's growth strategy.
Our LPMs are fully aligned and embedded within our priority Client relationship teams and our Global Product Groups (GPGs). You will be aligned to one/several of our GPGs, impacting how we deliver high end complex legal advice to our biggest clients.
You will work on client matters and deals, as a core part of the client team recording time against those matters. You will track workstreams, work with clients, monitor resourcing, manage budgets, and integrate our innovative solutions into our largest and most complex projects. You will also bring new ideas and expertise to an evolving role within a rapidly changing legal market.
Who you will work with
You will work day-to-day on a range of projects (legal matters), working across multiple client / sectors at any one time. These multi-disciplinary teams will be made up of trainees, lawyers, partners, legal tech advisors, practice assistants, business development professionals, billing, and anyone else in the firm who forms part of a client matter or deal team.  The focus of each of the teams you work with is to serve the client, and to deliver excellent legal advice and guidance, and to conclude the matter successfully.
You'll need to establish strong relationships with Practice Area Leaders, GPG Performance Directors, Business Development and a range of other internal stakeholders. You'll be able develop sustainable relationships, understanding stakeholder needs, identifying ways to address needs and demonstrate influencing skills to deliver the business objectives.
You will collaborate with other Legal Project Manager colleagues around our global network. You will also work closely with other members of the broader business professional community which includes Legal Technology Advisors, Resource Managers and Transformation Specialists.
What you will be responsible for
You'll support our partners working on some of the most complex matters with a chance to drive, deliver and implement outstanding project management on our largest legal matters.
What you will do
We are the front runners of innovation in the legal sector and everyone who joins our team becomes an integral part of shaping a rapidly developing area of law that is critical to the Firm's strategy.
• You will assist with the preparation of all project initiation documentation – such as prepare scope, resourcing and budget proposals for relevant matters or workstreams and then track progress against those proposals
• You will dissect problems and processes and apply logical and analytical approaches to solving them
• You will positively influence the individuals you work with (across a range of roles and seniority) to change and adapt their ways of working
• You will clearly explain theoretical concepts to senior stakeholders, including clients, and be comfortable amending your delivery approach and style
• You will manage effective planning:  over the short, medium and long term, then execute against those plans, such as documenting minutes, actions and tracking workstreams.  Throughout each project you will:
• Continually assess and understand where issues are and how they can be addressed and then provide and implement pragmatic solutions to ensure the programme moves forward
• Identify risks; such as conflicting deadlines, or a lack of skills, and then provide alternative solutions to mitigate the risk
• Monitor accruals and manage the project against agreed budgets including scope change
• You will advise, recommend and engage with legal technology tools available, to provide support to efficiently manage your projects
• You will demonstrate advanced knowledge and skills of working with the Best Delivery technology and you'll be able to define requirements and set-up technology to support efficient delivery
• You will assess the activities required and ensure we are delegating appropriate tasks to Legal Project Analyst team to efficiently manage your projects
• You will take regular feedback and direction from your colleagues, and adjust and adapt your style and plans
• You will deliver presentations and facilitate workshops and form part of the client pitch teams
• You will work directly with Clients, positively representing Clifford Chance and as required working from Client site locations independently

Qualifications
Your experience
You will have either have a background in (i) project management or legal operations, ideally gained within a professional services or complex matrix environment, or (ii) you will have been a lawyer with experience of matter management.
A qualification or industry recognised certification in project management would be desirable, but is not essential, as we are happy to support team members with these qualifications.
Collaboration, influencing and internal networking are all key skills to make an impact as a Legal Project Manager within the Firm.

Additional Information
How we will support you
From your first day with us, you will have varied opportunities to continuously grow and development your skills and knowledge. From formal training, informal coaching and mentoring through to skills-based and technical training and on the job learning.
Hybrid working
This role follows our 'balanced' hybrid working approach and as long as business needs allow, you will be supported to work in a hybrid way in line with the hybrid working policy.
What we offer including our broad range of benefits and working environment
When you join Clifford Chance, you will have access to a broad range of benefits to support you across many aspects of your personal and professional life including financial, wellbeing, lifestyle, and family friendly benefits. For more information on what we offer specifically in the UK, please visit our What We Offer page on our career site.
Equal opportunities
At Clifford Chance, we understand that our true asset is our people. Inclusion is good for our team and their families, our firm and society.
We are committed to treating all employees and applicants fairly and equally regardless of their gender, gender identity and expression, marital or civil partnership status, race, colour, national or ethnic origin, social or economic background, disability, religious belief, sexual orientation, or age.  This applies to recruitment and selection, terms and conditions of employment including pay, promotion, training, transfer and every other aspect of employment.
We have a variety of flourishing employee networks. These networks are a place for colleagues to share experiences and advocate for change wherever they see an opportunity for improvement.

Due to a fantastic period of growth, we are seeking a Principal Cable System Design Engineer to join our expanding Transmission & Distribution (T&D) team within AECOM. This is a senior role within the business, with responsibility for driving technical excellence, leading complex projects, and supporting strategic client engagement across a broad portfolio of high-voltage infrastructure schemes.
As a Principal Engineer, you will play a critical role in the planning, design, and delivery of cable systems across multiple voltage levels. Our clients include Transmission System Operators, Distribution Network Operators, private developers, and international energy majors across the UK and globally.
You will be a trusted advisor to clients, and contribute to developing our technical standards, innovation strategy, and digital delivery approach within the cable engineering space.
This is a fantastic opportunity to contribute to some of the most exciting infrastructure and energy transition projects in the world including National Grid’s Great Grid Upgrade.
Here’s what you will do:
• Assist with leading the delivery of large-scale HV/EHV cable system projects from concept to completion, ensuring quality, safety, and innovation throughout the lifecycle.

• Provide expert-level input into cable system ratings, installation methodologies, jointing arrangements, cleating design, and system integration in challenging environments.
• Guide and validate complex calculations including ampacity, short circuit forces, EMC, induced voltages, and thermomechanical forces to meet compliance with National Grid TPs, IEC, and CIGRÉ standards.
• Undertake client and stakeholder engagement, providing technical assurance, strategic direction, and value-engineered solutions on high-profile infrastructure programmes.
• Manage coordination between disciplines, including civil, structural, OHL, substation, and marine engineering inputs, to ensure cohesive and integrated design solutions.

• Conduct 3rd-party inspections, FAT/SAT witnessing and vendor oversight for cable and ancillary equipment.
• Champion mentorship, knowledge-sharing, and technical development within the wider team, supporting capability growth in cable systems engineering.
• Support business development activities, including proposals, bid reviews, and client presentations.

• In-depth understanding of international and UK-specific standards, particularly National Grid TPs, IEC, and CIGRÉ guidelines.
• Experience working in regulated, quality-assured environments—preferably with National Grid, SSE, EirGrid, or equivalent TSO/DNOs.
• Strong ability to coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams and engage with senior stakeholders across the project lifecycle.
• Excellent communication, client-facing, and team leadership/mentorship skills.
• Commitment to fostering innovation, digital delivery, and sustainability in design.
Desirable Certifications & Qualifications

About This Job
The Associate Director will contribute to developing, building and managing Shawbrook’s Financial Sponsors (‘FS’) lending activity, leading the structuring and execution of leveraged finance transactions in support of targeted levels of profitability, return on capital and origination. The role holder will propose, negotiate and execute Leveraged Finance facilities to support the acquisition and growth of UK SME companies by Private Equity firms and investors, while maintaining a high level of credit quality and operating to high standards of risk management, including operational, reputational and credit risk. The role will also involve actively managing client and intermediary relationships, originating new business, and mentoring more junior members of the team – reflecting Shawbrook’s purpose of combining deep sector expertise with the best banking brains to build a bank for the future.
Key Responsibilities
• Contribute to developing, building and managing Shawbrook’s Financial Sponsors (‘FS’) lending activity, achieving targeted levels of profitability, return on capital and origination
• Lead the structuring and execution of leveraged finance transactions
• Achieve a high level of credit quality and operate to high standards of risk management generally, including operational and reputational as well as credit risk
• Propose, negotiate and execute Leveraged Finance facilities to support the acquisition and growth of UK SME companies by Private Equity firms and investors; analyse the business and financial performance of prospective customers, ensure debt structures are appropriate to meet their needs, and identify, minimise and mitigate risks
• Take responsibility for the end-to-end credit process, including due diligence review, financial modelling, writing of credit papers, presentation to Credit, client negotiation and completion of legal documentation
• Actively manage ongoing relationships with a variety of clients (sponsors, investors) and intermediaries; originate business in the leveraged finance market, including participation in client and intermediary meetings, preparation of pitches, and attendance at market events and conferences
• Lead and support transactions, mentoring more junior staff, and relate effectively to other parts of the Shawbrook group that play their part in the Financial Sponsors output, i.e. Operations, Credit, HR, Finance and Corporate Banking
• Report all issues of regulatory concern to the Operations Director / Bank Legal & Compliance Director, communicate and escalate potential issues/risks in a prompt and effective manner, and provide support in managing the overall compliance and risk management framework of SF

Qualifications
Skills & Experience
• Proven experience in leveraged finance and/or growth capital lending, with experience in structuring and executing transactions and risk management. Compliance and governance experience, and some prior mentoring/line management experience, would be considered a positive.

About This Job
About the Role
We are looking for an Senior FP&A Analyst to join the IFS Copperleaf finance team, based in the UK. You will be one of five in a close-knit, high-calibre FP&A team, working together on the forecast, planning and reporting cycle while owning your own areas of forecasting, performance reporting and commercial analysis.
The rest of the team is based in Vancouver, so this role carries the European day. You will be the FP&A point of contact for stakeholders across the UK and Europe, working autonomously while your colleagues are offline and handing over cleanly across time zones. As one of the senior members of the team, you will be someone we can look to when the Director, FP&A is not in the room.
The value of this role is not in producing the numbers, it is in explaining them. We need someone with real commercial awareness who can see the bigger picture, get to the insight behind the movement and put a clear recommendation in front of decision-makers. You will act as a trusted finance business partner, working cross-functionally with leaders across the business, and will mentor and develop junior members of the FP&A team.
This is also a data-forward role. Copperleaf is a fast-paced, high-growth business and we expect this role to be fluent with data - comfortable querying source systems directly, building production reporting in the Power Platform, and using AI and agentic workflows to shorten the distance between question and answer. We want someone with the tenacity to keep finding improvements in efficiency, quality and capability, and the toolset and appetite to build them rather than wait for them.
Key Responsibilities
Commercial Insight and Business Partnering
• Act as a trusted finance business partner to leaders across the business - understand their drivers, challenge assumptions and hold the business to its numbers.
• Explain performance rather than report it: connect movements in revenue, cost, headcount and KPIs to what is actually happening commercially, and set out what it means.
• Provide the analysis behind investment cases, pricing decisions and strategic initiatives, with a clear recommendation attached.
• Be the FP&A presence through the European day - the point of contact for UK and European stakeholders while the Vancouver-based team is offline.
• Be a senior voice in the team - sharpening the work of others, representing FP&A with senior stakeholders and picking things up when the Director, FP&A is unavailable.
Forecasting and Planning
• Play a leading role in the monthly and quarterly forecast cycle - owning your inputs, assumptions and commentary, and working with the team to land the submission.
• Build and maintain the models that underpin the plan: recurring revenue and backlog, ARR and ACV, churn and retention, cost, headcount and long-range planning.
• Support the annual planning process, bringing a clear view of where the risks and opportunities sit.
Reporting and Analysis
• Own the management reporting and dashboards that leaders use to run the business, with a narrative attached to every pack.
• Analyse variances, trends, risks and opportunities across revenue, operating expenses, headcount and KPIs.
• Partner with Accounting to ensure results are reported accurately and consistently.
Data, Automation and AI
• Get to the data at source - write and maintain queries against finance and operational data sets rather than waiting on manual extracts.
• Build and maintain automated reporting across the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Query, Power BI, Power Automate).
• Design and build agentic workflows that remove manual effort from the reporting and forecast cycle and increase our speed to insight.
• Use AI routinely in day-to-day analysis and raise the data and AI capability of the wider FP&A team.
• Bring a continuous improvement mindset - actively look for opportunities to improve efficiency, quality and capability, and see them through to delivery.

Qualifications
Essential
• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field, or a qualified / part-qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA).
• 4-6 years of progressive FP&A, financial analysis or strategic finance experience.
• Strong commercial acumen, with a track record of influencing decisions rather than only producing analysis.
• Advanced Excel and financial modelling, with a solid grounding in accounting principles and the financial statements.
• Demonstrable experience working with large data sets and advanced data querying - SQL, Power Query / M or equivalent. You should be comfortable getting to the data yourself.
• Hands-on experience with the Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate), building and maintaining reporting rather than only consuming it.
• Practical experience embedding AI into finance workflows, with concrete examples of what you built, what it replaced and what it delivered.
• Able to tell the story behind the numbers and influence credibly at senior level.
• Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with the tenacity to drive continuous improvement.
• Comfortable working autonomously in a distributed, cross-time-zone team, with the judgement to make decisions and progress work without waiting for the wider team to come online.
Desirable
• Experience as a senior or lead analyst, including mentoring others or standing in for a finance lead.
• Experience building AI agents or agentic workflows (for example Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Claude, or Python-based agents).
• Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning or a comparable EPM / planning tool.
• Python or similar scripting for data manipulation.
• SaaS or technology sector experience, including exposure to recurring revenue metrics (ARR, ACV, churn, backlog) and project / services revenue recognition.

As a technical expert, you will produce accurate, concise reports and environmental assessments to meet regulatory and investigatory standards in riverine and estuarine environments.
Surveys will include but won’t be limited to; macroinvertebrates, fish, habitat and water quality surveys of rivers and lakes. If you are a motivated and skilled professional looking to make a significant impact and develop your career, we invite you to apply and join our growing team.

About This Job
At ASOS, we're building the next generation of AI-powered Search and Discovery experiences for millions of customers worldwide.
Our Search & Recommendations team develops the platforms, infrastructure and machine learning systems that power personalised product discovery, ranking, retrieval and recommendation experiences across ASOS. We operate high-scale production systems that enable data scientists and ML engineers to rapidly develop, deploy and monitor machine learning solutions in a reliable, scalable and cost-effective way.
We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer - with strong Engineering experience - who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges at scale. This role is ideal for someone with a strong software engineering/MLOps, distributed systems or platform engineering background who wants to work at the intersection of machine learning and production infrastructure.
As a Senior Engineer, you'll be responsible for designing, building and operating the platforms and services that enable machine learning models to be trained, deployed and served reliably across ASOS.
You'll work closely with Applied Scientists, Software Engineers, Data Engineers and Product Managers to create the tooling, infrastructure and deployment frameworks that power recommendation systems, search relevance, personalisation and emerging AI applications.
This is a highly engineering-focused role with an emphasis on cloud-native systems, platform architecture, automation, observability and operational excellence.
What You'll Be Doing:
• Design and build scalable machine learning platforms and infrastructure supporting model training, deployment and serving.
• Develop highly available backend services that power recommendation, search and personalisation experiences for millions of customers.
• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for machine learning and data products.
• Design batch and real-time inference architectures using modern cloud-native technologies.
• Improve reliability, resilience and performance across ML workloads through monitoring, observability and automation.
• Build tooling and frameworks that enable data scientists and ML engineers to deploy models safely and efficiently.
• Own production services, infrastructure and operational excellence practices, including incident management and root cause analysis.
• Optimise distributed compute workloads and resource utilisation across cloud environments.
• Drive Infrastructure-as-Code adoption and platform standardisation across machine learning systems.
• Contribute to architectural decisions across recommendation, search and AI platforms.
• Mentor engineers and promote software engineering best practices across the organisation.
• Help shape ASOS's long-term machine learning platform strategy.

Qualifications
We're interested in candidates who bring experience across modern software engineering, distributed systems and machine learning infrastructure. We recognise that expertise can be developed through a variety of backgrounds, including Backend Engineering, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Cloud Engineering, MLOps or Machine Learning Engineering.
We'd love to see experience in several of the following:
• Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience designing and building production systems at scale.
• Experience developing distributed systems, microservices or high-throughput backend platforms.
• Strong programming skills in Python, Java, Kotlin, Go, Scala or similar languages.
• Experience building and operating services in AWS, Azure or GCP environments.
• Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containerisation and cloud-native technologies.
• Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
• Knowledge of Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform, Pulumi or CloudFormation.
• Experience with monitoring, alerting and observability tooling.
• Experience building reliable, resilient and scalable systems with a focus on performance and operational excellence.
• Experience working with data-intensive systems, streaming technologies or large-scale distributed processing platforms.
• Exposure to machine learning systems, model serving, feature stores, training infrastructure or MLOps practices.
• Experience supporting recommendation systems, search platforms, personalisation engines or other customer-facing data products is advantageous.
• Comfortable providing technical leadership, mentoring engineers and influencing architectural direction.
• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working in cross-functional product teams.
• Experience supporting large-scale model training and inference workloads.
• Knowledge of vector search, ranking systems, retrieval architectures or recommendation platforms.
• Exposure to LLMs, Generative AI and production AI systems.
• Experience building internal developer platforms, engineering enablement tooling or shared capabilities used across multiple teams.

Additional Information
BeneFITS’

• Employee sample sales
• 25 days paid annual leave + an extra celebration day for a special moment
• Discretionary bonus scheme
• Private medical care scheme
• Flexible benefits allowance - which you can choose to take as extra cash, or use towards other benefits
• Opportunity for personalised learning and in-the-moment experiences that enable you to thrive and excel in your role

About This Job
Job Purpose / Overview
The Pressure Compliance Mechanical Engineer will report to the Pressure System Completions and Integration Manager and will take responsibility for managing the pressure systems compliance and structural integrity requirements on behalf of a specific scope identified by the Pressure System Completions and Integration Manager and Pressure Compliance Lead, ensuring appropriate implementation and compliance to meet HPC project needs.
The role holder will support the implementation of pressure systems compliance and structural integrity requirements within specific projects, on behalf of a specific programme. They will support the project managers in ensuring compliance and delivery for HPC.
The role will require good technical and organisational capabilities to effectively interface with Project Managers and relevant stakeholders in the programme, the ONR, third party organisations and support the supply chain in delivery.
Their team and role will act as the single point of contact for pressure systems compliance and structural integrity requirements – through all phases of the project and for the various project policies, for their allocated scope.
The role may require trips abroad (mostly mainland Europe).
Contextual Information
Hinkley Point C is one of the largest power generation projects in the world, and the first nuclear station for a generation to be built in the UK.
Within HPC, the Quality function provides the project with expertise in quality management, surveillance and pressure systems conformity assessment of the plant, through all stages of the development lifecycle.
The Pressure Compliance organisation sits within the Quality Function and is responsible for developing and delivering plant compliance for pressure systems structural integrity, conformity assessment and safety. The team interacts closely with many different stakeholders, including project managers, engineering design, manufacturing/installation companies and regulators.

• Support the development and maintenance of the pressure systems compliance and structural integrity requirements for their appointed work scope (normally specific projects within a programme).

• Manage on behalf of the Programme Pressure Compliance Lead the pressure systems compliance and structural integrity requirements.
• Maintain personnel SQEP status to support nuclear baseline requirements.
Dimensions

•
Companionship - conversing with the older person, spending time together and providing emotional support.

Daily Living - Assisting with washing, getting dressed, and, if needed, continence support.

About This Job
We are looking for a talented Network Engineer to join our growing global team at Sectigo.
The Network Engineer is responsible for supporting, implementing, managing, and maintaining the organization's networking infrastructure. This individual is detail-oriented, thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, and possesses a proven track record in learning, implementing, and maintaining enterprise networks and new technologies. Must be a commutable distance to Manchester DC, should the need arise.
Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:
• Network: Designing, planning, and implementing network infrastructure move, add, or changes. Including maintenance and support.
• Network Security: Implementing and maintaining network security protocols, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), VPNs, access control lists (ACLs), and encryption technologies to safeguard the organization's data and systems.
• Network Troubleshooting and Optimization: Diagnosing and resolving complex network issues, analyzing network performance, and optimizing network infrastructure to ensure high availability, reliability, and performance.
• Documentation and Reporting: Creating and maintaining network documentation, diagrams, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Generating reports on network performance, security incidents, and compliance status for management review.
• Capacity Planning: Assessing current and future network capacity requirements based on business growth projections and technology trends. Planning and implementing scalability solutions to accommodate increasing demand.
• Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring network infrastructure compliance with industry regulations, standards, and best practices (e.g., PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO, Webtrust). Conducting audits and implementing remediation measures as needed.
• Mounting and Installation: Ability to mount and install network devices such as routers, switches, and servers in data centers and office locations. This includes rack mounting, cable management, and hardware configuration. Candidates must be able to lift network equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.
• Travel & Operational Requirements:
• Participate in on-call rotation.
• Travel both internationally and nationally as needed (site support meetings, projects, etc.).
• Frequent visits to Datacenter near Manchester.
• Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.
More information about this role:
• This is a full-time and remote position based in U.K., with the ideal candidate reside within 1-hour driving distance to the greater Manchester area.
• The targeted compensation package for this role is between GBP 55,000 and 62,000 per annum, subject upon internal equity and years of experience.  We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends.

Qualifications
Education:
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or related field is strongly preferred.  Relevant certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE, CISSP) are a plus.
Experience:
• Proven experience (typically 5+ years) in network engineering roles, with a focus on supporting, implementing, and managing enterprise-scale network infrastructures.
• Automation and Infrastructure as Code (IAC):
• Ability to create, implement, and maintain automation using Terraform and Ansible.
• Proficiency with GIT.
• Comfortable with JSON, YAML, and XML.
• Knowledge of Python is a plus.
• Cloud Environments:
• AWS network experience is necessary (TGWs, Network ACLs, AWS Network Firewall, Security Groups, VPCs, Subnet,etc..), and general experience is required.
• Must be proficient in installing, implementing, supporting, and maintaining Juniper, Palo Alto, and Arista hardware and software for Datacenter and Campus environments.
• Knowledge of SD-WAN technologies such as Palo Alto, Aruba/Silverpeak, or Cisco/Viptela is a plus.
• Site to Site VPN: Must be able to design, implement, and support Route based and Policy based VPN. Knowledge of specific technologies such as DMVPN, FlexVPN, and other vendor-specific VPNs is a plus.
• RA VPN: Must be able to design, implement, and support enterprise VPNs such as Global Protect or AnyConnect.
• VXLAN: Understanding of overlay vs underlay and how it interacts with EVPN
• AAA: Must be able to support, implement, and maintain Radius and Tacacs+ for both device access management and NAC (e.g., 802.1x). SAML-based authentication is a plus.
• Network Monitoring: Must be able to implement, support, and use: Netflow, SNMP, and related enterprise tools (e.g., Solarwinds, Nagios, LiveNX).
• FW Technologies and Traffic Flow: Must understand stateful vs non-stateful rules, symmetric vs non-symmetric, NAT types, order of operation, etc.
• L3 Routing Protocols: Must have knowledge of OSPFv2, OSPFv3 and BGP. Knowledge of others such as ISIS and mBGP is a plus.
• L3: Must know IPv6. IPv4 and IPv6 dual stack is a plus.
• Layer 2: Must understand rSTP, dot1q, vlan, L2 security
• Wireless: Good understanding wireless, roaming, troubleshooting
• HA: Must understand FHRP (VRRP, HSRP, etc.), LACP, BFD, switch stacks.etc.
• TCP/IP: Must understand path MTU discovery (ICMP), basic TCP flags, etc.
• DNS, DHCP, ARP, Neighbor Discovery: Must have a good understanding.
• Segment Packet Frame troubleshooting: Must be comfortable packet captures and utilizing tools like Wireshark and tcpdump.

• In-depth knowledge of networking protocols and technologies, including TCP/IP, VLANs, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, etc.

• Proficiency in network hardware and software, such as Arista, Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Aruba, etc. Experience with SDN, SD-WAN, and cloud networking is desirable.
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex network issues.
• Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, and mentor junior staff.
• Attention to detail, organization, and documentation skills, with a commitment to maintaining accurate network documentation and following standard procedures.

About This Job
At EDF, Success is Personal. We don’t define it, you do. Join our Nuclear Safety Industrial Placement and you’ll shape your future while helping Britain achieve net zero. You’ll team up with experienced scientists and engineers who’ll support your growth and help you make a real impact across our nuclear fleet.
The Opportunity
This 12-month placement offers a starting salary of £26,050 and the chance to work within our Nuclear Safety team. You’ll support the Sizewell B safety case team and contribute to safe generation at the UK’s only operating PWR station.
You’ll gain exposure to short-term and long-term projects, with a particular focus on mechanical or structural integrity issues affecting the safety case for the plant. You’ll also have opportunities to visit operating nuclear stations and collaborate with EDF’s engineering teams.
What You’ll Experience
During your Placement, you’ll work with the Design Authority team to undertake reviews and analyses in support of safety assessments of for example the reactor pressure vessel or other components.
You’ll communicate with colleagues across the fleet, contribute to technical documentation, and take part in training to deepen your understanding of nuclear plant and engineering. This placement offers a unique opportunity to apply your academic knowledge in a real-world setting.
Your Work Location
Our #Gloucester office will be your main location, with hybrid working available throughout the placement. You’ll also have opportunities to visit nuclear power stations across the UK.
Who You Are
To be eligible for this EDF industrial placement, you need to be on track to achieve, or have already achieved, a 2:2 undergraduate or postgraduate degree in a relevant science or engineering degree.
It is a requirement that those who join us have the right to work in the UK. Whilst sponsorship may be a possibility, we reserve the right in our decisions to give priority to those who already have the right to work in the UK.
To be appointed to this role, you will need to meet the criteria for Security Vetting, which will, ordinarily, require you to have been a resident of the UK for at least three of the past five years.
Pay, Benefits and Culture
Alongside a starting salary of at least £26,050 per annum and a market-leading pension scheme, your package will include customisable benefits such as electric vehicle leasing, discounted gym membership, life assurance, tech vouchers, experience days, and more.
At EDF, we believe there are multiple definitions of what it means to succeed. That’s why we offer you the freedom to develop a career that’s unique to you. Here, Success is Personal – it’s your journey, powered by us.
Everyone is welcome at EDF; we’re committed to building a workforce that reflects gender balance, social mobility, and inclusion of minority ethnic backgrounds, LGBTQ+ communities, and those with disabilities.
As a Disability Confident employer, we're committed to creating an accessible recruitment process and encourage candidates to tell us about any support they may need. Should you disclose a disability and meet the minimum criteria (which will include holding a relevant degree discipline/grade and achieving the required pass mark for Stage 1 Testing) for the role you’ll be progressed to the first stage of the selection process. Some of our roles at EDF attract large volumes of applications. When this happens, we’ll apply the Disability Confident scheme’s guidance on taking practical and appropriate steps selecting disabled candidates who best meet the minimum criteria for the job.
Our Recruitment Process
We'll guide you through every stage and keep you updated along the way. You'll be supported by real people, with opportunities to ask questions, learn more and receive feedback where possible.
For our Early Careers Programmes, we use a combination of automated decision-making, assessment technology and human review.
Find out more by visiting: https://careers.edfenergy.com/articles/2025-8/AI-and-Automated-Decision-Making-in-Recruitment-at-EDF
Join us and find your success at EDF.

This isn't just about designing processes; it's about owning the blueprint for our future. Design the Blueprint for How We Work

Transformation-Driven TOM Development: Lead the design of Target Operating Models (TOMs) for assigned strategic programmes and projects, defining the required operational architecture, key capabilities, and integration points necessary to deliver project outcomes and drive sustainable organisational transformation.

Cross-Functional Blueprint: Create the programme-level operational blueprint and strategic blueprints that clearly outline the future structure of work, providing the necessary input for the Organisational Design function to define detailed people structures and roles.

Stakeholder Management: Secure project and programme stakeholder buy-in and maintain alignment across delivery workstreams by presenting model diagnostics, design options, and implementation readiness plans.

Industry Acumen: Maintain a deep understanding of industry trends, best practices, and emerging organisational models (e.g., agile, matrix structures).

Leadership Communication: Prepare and present formal recommendations, impact assessments, and reports on programme and project operating model designs to the Strategy and Transformation leadership.

This is a first-line product compliance role. You will work directly alongside engineers and product managers to translate regulatory obligations into product decisions that are scalable, defensible and globally consistent.
Your mission
Keeping pace with how money moves.  As Wise expands into new markets, corridors, and payment schemes, the rules governing how transfers are processed, and who can send them, become increasingly complex. You will own the compliance strategy for core product flows that determine customer eligibility: how we verify where customers live, how we handle customers who move between countries, and how we allocate customers to the right licensed entity. These aren't abstract compliance questions, they manifest directly in product screens, data models, and engineering decisions. You will need to go deep quickly, surface the "so what," and drive alignment between legal, product, and engineering teams across multiple markets.
Strengthening the infrastructure for regulatory accountability. Wise is continuously evolving the regulatory infrastructure that helps us demonstrate compliance across our licences, markets, and products. This platform connects our regulatory obligations to the policies, controls, … You'll help shape and strengthen this capability by partnering with engineers, product teams, and compliance specialists to ensure regulatory obligations are accurately reflected in our systems and translated into appropriate controls. About This Job
We're rebuilding how IFS ships software around autonomous, AI-native teams, and we're looking for someone to lead one. You'll write production code following agentic engineering principles, own it in production, and set the bar for a small team of engineers who do the same.
The software you'll build runs the real world. It's the workforce management & planning, project delivery and scheduling systems that construction and engineering companies use to run major programs. The people using it are planners, schedulers, project managers and site teams whose decisions carry real cost and real risk. When your code is right, their projects land. That's the feedback loop, and it's a good one.
What makes this different
We treat AI-assisted development as a core capability, not a novelty. Claude Code and Cursor are part of the daily workflow here, not something on a "tools we're evaluating" slide. We build agentic and LLM-backed features into the product, using RAG, agentic architectures, evaluation harnesses and context engineering, where they solve a real customer problem rather than chase a trend. If you've already changed how much you can ship and how fast because of the way you work with these tools, you'll be in good company.
We work in a forward-deployed way. You'll get into real customer environments, and shape the technical decisions, rather than working from a requirements document written by someone who's never been on site. Your goal will be to use these oppurtunities to bring customers the most value.
And you'll own the whole thing: design, build, test, deploy and run. Modern general-purpose languages, full stack, on a cloud-native platform with Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC/GitOps and observability. Quality and security are built in as you go, not bolted on by a downstream gate.
What you'll do
Lead a small, autonomous team by setting technical direction, driving delivery and quality, and growing the engineers around you. Design and ship full-lifecycle features across front-end and back-end. Build and consume the APIs and event-driven services that connect workforce, project, scheduling and financial data across IFS Cloud and customer systems. Make performance and scalability decisions that hold under load. Get into customer environments, test your assumptions against reality, and bring that evidence back into the build. Document the why, not just the what, and help raise the practice of everyone you work alongside.

Qualifications
What we're looking for
A strong engineer who genuinely enjoys leading people and wants to stay close to the code while doing it. You take ownership without being asked, make progress when the brief is half-formed, and would rather ship and iterate than wait for perfect. You have depth in at least one area, whether that's front-end, back-end, data, quality, security, platform or applied AI, and the range to work across the stack. You've led or mentored engineers, and people tend to get better for having worked with you. You reason from the customer and commercial outcome as much as the technical one. And you're genuinely fluent with AI tools and agentic patterns in real engineering work, not just familiar with them.
Nice to have
A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or the equivalent proof in what you've built. Experience shipping AI-backed features such as LLM integration, RAG or agentic patterns. Experience with enterprise, ERP or project-based software, or exposure to construction, engineering or other field-heavy industries. Experience of agile delivery with globally distributed teams and leading them.

Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

An exciting opportunity has arisen for Craft Mechanical and Electrical Apprentices to join the Filton Plant in the wing build production environment.
Filton Plant is proud to be responsible for the complete wing Assembly and equipping of the A400M. To date, over 270 wings have been delivered across the world. ● Drilling, reaming and countersinking;
● Use of automated drilling equipment;
● Fastening & sealing;
● Sub and major assembly of aircraft components;
● Fuel, Hydraulic, Pneumatic & Electrical installation;
● System function testing.

12
About the Role
S&P Global Ratings' Structured Finance CMBS team evaluates the credit risk of securitized commercial mortgage structures, analyzing underlying asset performance, structural protections, cash-flow mechanics, and downside stress scenarios to produce independent credit opinions that help issuers and investors compare complex instruments. Based in London, you will lead analytical coverage of a defined CMBS portfolio, mentor junior analysts, and drive the responsible adoption of AI-enabled workflows — contributing to market insights on performance trends, issuance conditions, and emerging themes in commercial real estate.
What You'll Do
Impact
You will contribute to independent credit opinions that the commercial mortgage securitization market depends on. Your analytical leadership will maintain the quality and consistency of S&P Global's CMBS coverage, your coaching of junior analysts will deepen the team's commercial real estate credit expertise, and your contribution to AI-enabled workflows will help the team deliver faster, more rigorous, and more consistent insights.
Responsibilities
Team Contribution & Capability Building
• Act as a senior reference for junior analysts, coaching on CMBS credit fundamentals, financial modeling, data quality, and responsible AI use; coordinate portfolio workflows, proactively manage capacity and quality risks, and drive continuous improvement through refined processes and the governed rollout of new tools.
Core Analytical & Delivery
• Deliver end-to-end analytical execution across a defined CMBS portfolio — including new transaction analysis and ongoing surveillance — reconciling credit inputs, documenting assumptions and model changes, and maintaining consistently high standards of analytical quality and clarity.
• Use approved generative AI tools to accelerate research, comparisons, and drafting, with rigorous validation and full accountability for all outputs.
Stakeholder & Market Engagement
• Translate data, analysis, and research into market-facing narratives for issuers, investors, and senior market participants; build trusted stakeholder relationships and contribute to thought leadership on CMBS and commercial real estate trends.
Risk Management & Operations
• Maintain strict adherence to methodology, confidentiality, and data governance requirements; escalate emerging risks early and embed responsible AI practices with appropriate governance and human oversight throughout all workflows.
What We're Looking For
Required Skills and Experience
• Specialized experience in commercial real estate finance and/or CMBS, including leading new transaction analysis and ongoing portfolio surveillance.
• Strong credit and financial analysis skills in structured finance, with the ability to translate complex CMBS data into clear, decision-useful narratives grounded in evidence and sound judgment.
• Proven ability to coach and advise junior colleagues on credit fundamentals, operational processes, and quality standards, with a track record of delivering high-quality outputs with limited oversight.
• Practical experience integrating generative AI or large language model tools into analytical workflows to drive productivity, with the ability to shape AI and automation use cases within appropriate governance and change management frameworks.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills for committee-ready documentation and engagement with issuers, investors, and market participants.
• A continuous improvement mindset, with experience simplifying and standardizing analytical processes through tooling, automation, or workflow redesign.

At S&P Global Ratings, our analyst-driven credit ratings, research, and sustainable finance opinions provide critical insights that are essential to translating complexity into clarity so market participants can uncover opportunities and make decisions with conviction. By bringing transparency to the market through high-quality independent opinions on creditworthiness, we enable growth across a wide variety of organizations, including businesses, governments, and institutions.
S&P Global Ratings is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI).  S&P Global is the world’s foremost provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets. With every one of our offerings, we help many of the world’s leading organizations navigate the economic landscape so they can plan for tomorrow, today.
For more information, visit www.spglobal.com/ratings

Our Mission:
Advancing Essential Intelligence.

accenture.wd103.myworkdayjobs.com/accent.description_excerpt:
Digital Finance Transformation Manager
Career level: Manager (CL7)  |  Location: London / Manchester / Edinburgh  |  Practice: Finance Reinvention Partner (Platform Transformation)
Why this role
This is where a finance-transformation manager takes ownership of the design in front of the client. You'll lead the finance design on major transformation programmes: running the discovery, settling the process and enterprise-structure decisions everything downstream depends on, and holding the line on them with finance leadership. Much of that work sits where systems meet: where the finance core hands off to consolidation, planning and reporting, and where the enterprise structure has to hold across all of them. You advise on the right finance technology and target operating model for the problem, whatever the client runs, and you grow from here into a design authority clients ask for by name.
Accenture is a leading solutions and services company. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI. Finance is one of seven Reinvention Partners at the centre of that, bringing the CFO agenda to life for clients: stronger performance, sharper insight, and better control.
"Our clients want a partner that can help them reinvent—boldly, continuously and at speed… while continuously building the most client-focused, AI-enabled great place to work for our people—our Reinventors." — Julie Sweet, Chair and CEO
What you'll bring
Fit-to-standard and finance process design. You lead fit-to-standard and process design across the core finance processes (Record-to-Report, Order-to-Cash, Purchase-to-Pay and Acquire-to-Retire) and across general accounting, close and consolidation, external and management reporting, intercompany, finance master data and finance controls. You take a client's requirements, run a structured fit-gap, and turn the result into a process design the business will run. That design closes faster, reports with more confidence, and strengthens control. Where the client wants something the standard doesn't do, you're the person who works out whether the answer is to change the process or change the design, and can argue either case on its merits.
Enterprise structure and chart of accounts. You can design and defend the finance backbone: legal-entity and company-code structure, ledgers, the controlling and profit-centre model, cost-centre and hierarchy design, and the chart of accounts across it. These decisions are expensive to revisit once a programme is moving, so you'll bring a point of view: what the reporting and statutory requirements demand, where a dimension serves better than an account, and how the structure holds as the group changes shape.
Finance design authority and senior stakeholder management. You own the design end to end in front of the client: chairing the design conversations, bringing options and a recommendation, writing the decision papers and driving them to closure. You work directly with finance leadership, from controllers and FP&A leads to process owners and the CFO's team, taking a contested design point, explaining the trade-off in business terms and getting an answer. You set the design standard for the finance workstream and coach the consultants around you.
Technology selection, vendor assessment and the value case. You lead technology selection and vendor assessment: framing the criteria, comparing platforms against what the client needs, and building a defensible recommendation and roadmap. You own the value case and business case behind it: the benefits, the cost of the change, and how the return on a platform investment gets tracked once the programme starts, argued in the terms a CFO signs off against.
AI in finance processes, and in how we deliver. You'll bring a working fluency in what AI is doing to the finance function, enough to hold a credible conversation with finance leadership: where it changes a process, whether reconciliations, close tasks, intercompany matching or forecasting, where it does not yet, and what has to be true of the data and controls first. You design AI-enabled ways of working into the target process: what an agent runs, what a person approves, where the human check and the audit trail sit. The same judgement applies to how we work. We're increasingly an AI-first delivery team, and you decide where AI-augmented delivery earns its place and what the team reuses. If your AI experience is newer than the rest of your track record, tell us what you've done with it.
Platform literacy and integration judgement. You've delivered on enterprise finance platform programmes (SAP, Oracle or comparable finance platforms) and you understand how one runs: how a design gets built, what "standard" means in practice, and what a technology decision costs downstream. Finance rarely sits on one system, so you can work through how the finance core connects to what surrounds it: the master data that has to agree, the interfaces between them, and the reporting layer reading from both. Where a process crosses that boundary, you design it to hold on both sides.
Target operating model and design-thinking delivery. You shape the operating model around the design: how the finance function, its shared-services or GBS arrangements and its process ownership need to work once the platform lands. You facilitate design-thinking workshops, co-develop solutions with the client in the room, and secure design decisions in an agile, iterative way, not through documents alone.
Shaping the work. At this level you start to see the next piece of work before anyone asks for it. You'll spot where a client has an unaddressed problem, shape a proposition around it with the team, and contribute to how we position and solution it. Origination and deal shaping are part of the Manager trajectory here, not something reserved for the level above.
Who you are
You take ownership and follow through, and you're comfortable being the person the client turns to when a design decision is stuck. You work well with ambiguity in a complex finance organisation and can hold a clear view without needing to win the room. You lead a team well, build trusted relationships across a client's management, and manage expectations and timelines when more is asked of the design than it can carry. You're closely engaged with what AI is changing in finance: you've formed your own view, and can advise a client on it instead of repeating what a vendor told them.
Things that set strong candidates apart: a track record (typically 7+ years) designing finance transformation on enterprise platform programmes; experience across more than one ERP or finance platform; work at the seams, where finance integrates with the systems and processes around it; leading a technology selection and the business case behind it through to a decision; depth in enterprise structure and chart-of-accounts design; designing AI-enabled ways of…

Job Description: Senior AI Platform Engineer
How does this role contribute to our collective success?
The Senior AI Platform Engineer will help AXIS deliver secure, reliable, and reusable AI capabilities that support business teams across underwriting, claims, operations, and other strategic functions. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, DevOps, data engineering, and applied AI, with a focus on productionising AI services safely and consistently.
You will design, build, deploy, and operate cloud-native AI workloads, including LLM-powered services, agentic workflows, data pipelines, and reusable platform components. You will play a key role in improving engineering standards, automation, observability, release discipline, and operational readiness across AXIS AI platforms.
This is a hands-on senior engineering role for someone who can take ownership from design through production support, work effectively with distributed teams, and help shape pragmatic, maintainable approaches to enterprise AI delivery.
What will you do in this role?
• Design, build, and operate production-grade AI services, data pipelines, and platform capabilities on Azure and Databricks.
• Develop LLM-powered and agentic workflows that support business process automation, document intelligence, orchestration, and decision support.
• Expose AI capabilities through secure, maintainable APIs and Azure Function or Container App backend services, including FastAPI-based or other services where appropriate.
• Own CI/CD delivery pipelines for AI and data workloads, including build, release, deployment, validation, and environment promotion.
• Implement infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and Azure-native tooling, ensuring environments are repeatable, secure, and supportable.
• Build and manage Databricks jobs, workflows, asset bundles, and data engineering pipelines.
• Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting using OpenTelemetry or equivalent observability tools.
• Support production AI systems, including incident response, troubleshooting, operational runbooks, release readiness, and service improvement.
• Contribute to architecture decisions, engineering standards, reusable patterns, and platform strategy.
• Collaborate with engineering, data science, product, security, infrastructure, and business teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.
• Mentor engineers, lead technical enablement sessions, and promote strong engineering practices across the team.
What will you need to succeed?
Required skills and experience
• Strong production-level Python engineering experience, with the ability to build maintainable, tested, and supportable services.
• Experience with PySpark or equivalent large-scale data processing frameworks.
• Hands-on experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or similar tooling.
• Experience deploying and supporting workloads on Azure, including identity, access control, networking, and secure resource configuration.
• Practical experience with infrastructure-as-code, preferably Terraform.
• Experience building APIs, backend services, and service integrations for data or AI workloads.
• Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, incident response, and operational support for production systems.
• Strong engineering discipline across testing, code quality, branching, release management, and automated validation.
• Ability to troubleshoot across application, data, infrastructure, deployment, and security boundaries.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Desirable skills and experience
• Experience with Databricks Jobs, Workflows, Asset Bundles, Apps, and medallion-style data architectures.
• Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, LLM-based application development, or agent SDKs and frameworks.
• Experience with MLflow, model lifecycle management, evaluation, tracing, and AI observability.
• Experience with containers, Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, OpenShift, or equivalent container platforms.
• Experience building reusable platform components, shared libraries, templates, or engineering standards.
• Experience working in regulated environments with strong security, governance, auditability, and operational control requirements.
What good looks like
• AI services are delivered with clear ownership from design through deployment and production support.
• Delivery pipelines are automated, repeatable, secure, and aligned to release management standards.
• Systems are observable, supportable, and designed with reliability, scalability, and operational readiness in mind.
• Engineering approaches are pragmatic, maintainable, reusable, and suitable for enterprise adoption.
• Incidents, risks, and technical dependencies are surfaced early, communicated clearly, and resolved collaboratively.
• The engineer improves the wider team through mentoring, standards, reusable patterns, and technical leadership.
Role factors
• This role requires close collaboration with distributed technology, business, data, security, infrastructure, and vendor teams.
• The successful candidate will be expected to work independently, manage competing priorities, and provide clear technical leadership.
• The role involves hands-on engineering delivery as well as contribution to standards, architecture, production support, and operational improvement.
• The candidate should be comfortable engaging with stakeholders, explaining technical decisions clearly, and supporting local and global team objectives.

About the Role
Everest is seeking a Senior Analyst, Finance Data & Reporting, a senior specialist with significant financial reporting and controls experience and advanced data, systems and automation capabilities. The role owns complex finance reporting deliverables, strengthens source-to-report integration, reconciliations and lineage, and leads cross-system data investigation and resolution. It supports controlled, scalable business-as-usual reporting and finance transformation, including finance data domain implementation. The preferred candidate combines substantial practical finance experience with further formal qualifications in data and systems.
Role & Responsibilities (include but not limited to):
• Own the delivery and integrity of finance reporting datasets, cubes, reports and dashboards across entities, currencies and accounting bases.
• Automate finance data and reporting processes using SQL, Power Query, Power BI and VBA; apply AI with validation and human oversight to improve accuracy, efficiency and scalability.

• Deliver data, analysis and reporting solutions for Financial Reporting, FP&A, Tax, Actuarial and Group Finance, reflecting cut-off, foreign exchange and reporting-basis differences.
• Maintain documentation, reporting logic and reconciliation evidence for repeatable delivery, auditability, access control and change management.
