Aberdeen plc is one of Europe’s largest investment companies, and we are built on a long-standing culture of caring about the future and making a positive impact. Together we invest for a better future. We do it to make a difference to the lives of our clients and customers, our employees, society, and our shareholders. Our business is structured around three distinct areas focused on our clients' changing needs: Aberdeen Investments, Aberdeen Adviser, and interactive investor.
As Billing Lead, you will help bring “Invest in your tomorrow” to life by leading accurate, well-controlled billing operations that support stronger outcomes for our clients and our business.
About the Department
Finance Operations is a core part of Aberdeen’s Finance function, delivering services across Record to Report, Billing, Banking, Accounts Payable and Supplier Relationship Management. Within Group Financial Control, the team provides accurate financial outputs, strong controls and valuable insight, working with colleagues in Edinburgh and an outsourced partner in Chennai. Billing supports revenue recognition, regulatory compliance and the integrity of Accounts Receivable balances, helping enable our clients to be better investors.
About the Role
This finance operations Billing leadership role is a high-impact leadership opportunity within Finance Operations in Edinburgh. You will oversee invoicing, collections, the Billing Helpdesk, controls, risk management and continuous improvement. Leading seven Edinburgh-based direct reports and an offshore billing team of around 20 colleagues, you will build capability and ensure accurate, timely and compliant outcomes. You will own aged debt, cash collection, data integrity and balance sheet substantiation, while representing Billing at risk, audit and governance forums. The role offers the chance to invest in your tomorrow by shaping a scalable operating model, embedding automation and strengthening a high-performance culture.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead Billing Operations across invoicing, collections and helpdesk activity, ensuring accurate, timely and compliant outcomes.
• Oversee complex fee calculations, including management fees, recharges, investment management agreement fees, performance fees and rebates.
• Own aged debt and cash collection performance, reducing overdue balances and improving cash flow.
• Lead the Billing control environment, ensuring regulatory compliance, risk management, audit readiness, data integrity and robust balance sheet substantiation.
• Drive the Billing change agenda through process improvement, automation, standardisation and technology-enabled efficiency.
About the Candidate
Essential requirements
• Extensive experience in Finance Operations Billing within a complex and regulated environment.
• Strong people leadership experience across billing, collections and client-facing support functions, including leading multi-layered onshore and offshore teams.
• Deep understanding of billing processes, complex fee structures, Accounts Receivable and collections.
• Strong understanding of financial controls, risk management and regulatory requirements.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence at senior levels.
• Ability to operate strategically while maintaining oversight of operational delivery and team performance.
Preferred and desirable experience
• Preferred: proven experience managing aged debt and improving cash collection performance.
• Preferred: experience ensuring robust balance sheet substantiation and audit readiness.
• Preferred: proven track record of leading change and transformation initiatives.
• Preferred: experience leveraging automation, systems and process improvements to drive efficiency.
• Desirable: familiarity with Oracle ERP systems, particularly where leading teams that use Oracle in day-to-day operations.
• Desirable: familiarity with Revenue Management systems, particularly where leading teams that rely on these platforms.

Do you have proven experience of identifying and driving new employer engagement opportunities and converting effectively?
Do you have experience of working with employers to secure suitable vacancies, placement opportunities, or workforce solutions?
Then consider the role of Key Account Manager at Reed in Partnership!
What is the role about?
North Sea Jobs Service (NSJS) is a voluntary transition service for current and former UK-resident oil gas workers who have worked in the industry within the last 2 years. It is commissioned by the UK Government, specifically the Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (DESNZ). Workers can access up to 12 months of tailored support, with the primary aim to create employment opportunities through employer and trade union engagement and provide Workers with tailored employment support and training.
The Key Account Manager is responsible for the management of key Employer Relationships and for the sourcing of sustainable employment opportunities for NSJS Workers, ensuring service levels exceed stakeholders and employers’ expectations. The Key Account Manager will utilise their relationships and understanding of employers’ current and future business and skills needs to map these to training pathways for individuals, ensuring Workers benefit from training and opportunities that are responsive to labour market needs. This may include relevant roles in Clean Energy, and also Industry Priority Sectors (e.g. Advanced Manufacturing, Construction, Life Sciences etc).
Please note, the Key Account Manager may be required to travel around the UK when needed, including to Aberdeen where we will have an NSJS office.
Just some of your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
• Ensures Employer requirements and expectations are met via Reed in Partnership’s and/or partners’ network.
• Represents Reed in Partnership at external meetings to keep abreast of employment opportunities in the area, identifying opportunities to influence the design and approach of such initiatives / new opportunities.
• Work with employers to secure suitable vacancies, or placement opportunities for Workers.
• Identifies and drives new employer engagement opportunities and converts effectively.
• Promotes and creates an awareness of the entire offering of NSJS including work placements as well as vacancies.
• Maximises on repeat business with key employers.
• Identifies other employer-led business opportunities when opportunities arise, e.g. growth sectors.
• Ensuring that NSJS provision is responsive and demand-led to employer and worker needs.
What’s in it for you?
A generous base salary (pro-rata for part time), and great flexibility with your working schedule, we offer training, development and progression opportunities. You will have access to the range of Reed in Partnership benefits, which include:

• Plus much more that can be found on our website
• With the chance to dramatically make a difference to the local community, this role offers immense job satisfaction.
At Reed in Partnership, we live and breathe our values in every decision and action taken, resulting in a collaborative and enjoyable culture within our offices. Our company values – we are fair open and honest; we take ownership, and we work together.
To be successful in this role, we are looking for someone with:
• BPSS (Baseline Personnel Security Standard)
• Experience and track record of working in an account management or business development role.
• A personal track record of working towards and achieving targets.
• A minimum of 2 A-Levels or an equivalent Level 3 Diploma.
• GCSE English Language at a minimum of a Grade B (or equivalent Level 2 qualification). OR achievement of a Level 2 in Literacy Assessment at interview stage.
Essential Criteria
• Key Account Managers’ attributes include Achievement Orientation, Challenge and Resilience, Flexibility and Adaptability, Honesty and Integrity, Impactful Communication, Planning and Decision Making, Selling and Influencing and Team Orientation.
• Technical skills including good knowledge of the national labour market, knowledge of employment legislation governing recruitment practices, good knowledge of partners/stakeholders, analytical ability to use intelligence to maximise on business opportunities, very strong written and verbal communication skills, negotiation skills, accomplished networking skills, organisational and time management skills, ability to build professional relationships effectively.

Job Description:
Leonardo has an exciting opportunity for a Lead Systems Engineer/Design Authority (DA) to join its NATO JEWCS Integrated Project Team (IPT), within the CEMA and ICS Sector based across the south of the UK. We are producing the next generation Electronic Warfare (EW) Training System assets covering Land, Sea and Air together with an IT infrastructure to enable effective planning, programming and review for NATO exercises.
Your impact
As Lead Systems Engineer and Design Authority, you will be responsible for providing the technical oversight and expertise at all levels of the overall system solution, working with both internal and supplier design teams to ensure that the architecture of the overall system solution is developed and delivered to meet the Customer and business requirements.
Working across the whole of the systems engineering lifecycle, as part of a multi-disciplined team, the successful candidate will seek advice from SMEs to review and advise on the creation and verification of subsystem technical solutions lead the directly supporting the Project Chief Engineer in ensuring the system and sub system designs are:
• fit for purpose and due consideration has been made for the integrity of the design
• compliant with customer requirements and required standard
• safety of the overall proposed architecture is maintained and assessed
As a result, strong technical, delivery, and people leadership skills and abilities are essential in this role, particularly the ability to discuss and resolve complex technical problems in the EW domain.
This role will see the successful candidate join the quickly expanding engineering team within the CEMA and ICS sector and take on a key role in shaping the future of the NATO JEWCS deployed solution combining use of COTS with the latest technologies and ensuring that they meet the needs of the customer.
• Work closely with the Project Chief Engineer to identify and resolve technical issues across the whole system and subsystems and to ensure the integrity of the solution.
• Deputise for the Project Chief Engineer within the project.
• Lead the architecture team to develop and document the architecture thought the project lifecycle.
• Influence all levels of requirements to enable design and development decisions and trade-offs to be made.
• Provide direction, control, evaluation and recommendations relating to technical risks and opportunities.
• Support test planning and requirements verification to achieve certification and delivery for the overall system.
• Working with and influencing key project stakeholders including customer and end users.
• Present Architecture material at Design reviews internally and externally for the overall system.
• Act as a technical interface between the end customer and the Leonardo Engineering team.
• Actively support knowledge sharing and exploitation of best practice.
• Support the guidance and development of junior Systems Engineers within the Engineering team.
• Contribute to the successful achievement of engineering milestones as an integrated part of the Prime team.
• Support and advise sub-system design teams through their design reviews.
• Travel within the UK and abroad to meet with our customers and industry partners.
What you’ll bring
Required
• A degree (or equivalent experience) in a STEM subject and strong numerical, analytical and design skills, with the ability to apply these to real world problems.
• Strong understanding of system and project lifecycles as applicable to delivery of sub-systems, technical and commercial baselines, and change control.
• Strong understanding of Systems Architecture activities as part of the Systems Lifecycle.
• Self-motivated with a strong aptitude for problem-solving and decision-making within projects involving design complexity and uncertainty.
• Strong experience of influencing system design and integration of a major system.
• Strong experience in stakeholder management within organisations and with customers (internal or external) in a high-pressure environment, pulling in technical expertise when and where appropriate.
• Experience of successfully passing Design Reviews and implementing potentially complex remedial actions with sub-contract equipment suppliers and Prime integration teams.
Ideally
• Knowledge of military EW/radar passive and active RF.
• Strong understanding of systems integration and progressive assurance.
• Experience of making design decisions by trading-off alternate solution based on functionality, performance and cost.
• Chartered engineer / member of the Institute of Engineering and Technology (IET)
This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skill is a good attitude and willingness to learn.
Security Clearance
This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personnel Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV). Job Description:
Start date: September 2027
Location: Stevenage
Duration: 3 years
Application: We love your interest in joining Airbus! 37 hours per week // Up to 2 Flexi Days per month // 25 days holiday plus bank holidays // Pension // Plus many more flexible benefits!
​​About Us
Airbus is Europe’s number one Defence and Space enterprise, so what better way to start your Craft Apprenticeship than with an industry leader.
Being a Panels Manufacturing Technician Craft Apprentice at Airbus means you will get to develop Mechanical skills within our programme. You will be immersed in a stimulating Manufacturing environment.
As a Panels Manufacturing Technician Craft Apprentice, you'll gain hands-on experience in a highly specialized and stimulating manufacturing environment. You'll develop essential mechanical skills while working on large, complex Satellite Panels that are then built into a Satellite Structure. This is your chance to contribute to missions that will explore our solar system, protect our planet, and provide vital communication services.
This role is for someone who wants to turn their passion for practical skills into a career that is literally out of this world! You will be immersed in a supportive team of experts who will mentor you as you build components that will endure the harsh realities of space.
What you will be doing
Year 1: You will study towards a Level 2 Engineering Operative ST0537 on the materials and processing pathway, gaining both academic knowledge and practical experience.
Year 2: During the Apprenticeship you will have a unique opportunity to experience different Production Areas of the business which will provide you with a comprehensive understanding of how a Satellite is manufactured at Airbus Defence & Space. This includes working in small teams or on a one-to-one basis to manufacture Spacecraft Panels, Mirror Bonding and Treatments using the latest approved processes and advanced production techniques for Satellite manufacture.
Your key activities & responsibilities will be:
Panel Assembly
• Use of various different adhesives
• Use of hand measuring tools to meet tight tolerances
• Installation of various panel features (potting inserts, riveting, edge taping)
• Following process and tolerances to drawings on 3DX
Final Assembly
• Installation of panel features including Ty-bases, MLI (multi-layer insulated blankets) studs, connector brackets & cleats and brackets using laser technology
• Heat pipe installation to extremely tight tolerances as low as 0.15mm
Mirror bonding
• Use of silicone adhesive to install SSM (second surface mirrors) to various types of panels and spacecraft features.
• Cutting mirrors with diamond tip pens to extreme accuracy
Treatments
• Surface finish measurements such as friction and paint thickness
• Application of surface finishes including aerospace approved primers and paints
• Grit blasting
• Conversion coatings and protective finishes
• Masking of hardware in preparation for spraying
During the 2nd year of the apprenticeship, you will attend a week of Team Building Activities and Exercises at one of the Outward-Bound UK Sites. Split up into teams consisting of Apprentices of all levels from various Airbus Defence and Space sites, you will work as a team to complete daily activities such as Rock Climbing, Hiking, Abseiling, Canoeing and more
Year 3: You will be fully on-site, fine tuning your hand skills against the business skills matrix.
Requirements
• Funding Eligibility: Applicants must be aged 16–21* and cannot hold a Level 2 or higher qualification (e.g., NVQ, BTEC, HND, or Degree) in Engineering, Aerospace, or related technical fields. For more information, please consult Foundation Apprenticeships Criteria*
• Education: No strict formal entry requirements, though a Grade 3 (or equivalent) in GCSE Maths and English is desirable.
• Skills & Attributes: Strong communication, reliability, excellent work ethic, a can-do attitude, and the ability to follow technical instructions and work well independently or in a team.
• No prior experience required—full on-the-job training will be provided.

What is it about Airbus that makes you excited to start a career with us? Is it our aircraft, innovation, global impact, or something else? Let us know what interests you about our work and why we stand out to you.
• Why a hands-on apprenticeship?
Why do you want to learn by doing? We’d love to hear what draws you to practical, skills-based learning.
• Show your hands-on experience.
In your CV or cover letter, include any hands-on activities or hobbies where you've used practical skills. These could be things like:
•
• DIY projects
• Building and fixing things
• Doing make-up or beauty work
• Tinkering and Tech Projects
• Building models
• Baking or cooking
• Others
Show Us What You've Built!
We love seeing what you are passionate about. If you've worked on any hands-on projects—whether it's building, baking, fixing something —we'd be thrilled to see it!
Feel free to attach photos, documents, or a short video showcasing a project you're proud of. This isn't a requirement, but it’s a fantastic way to give us a glimpse of your practical skills. We can't wait to see your work!

Advising clients and law firms in a range of data-driven engagements within the framework of legal action or internal investigations.

Leading client relationships, ensuring projects are delivered to the highest technical and ethical standards.

Acting as an expert witness — drafting and peer reviewing formal statements, preparing expert reports and providing oral evidence in court or arbitration.

Leading complex digital forensic investigations across a broad range of devices, data systems and cloud environments.

Directing mobile device forensic analysis, including advanced extraction, decryption, and interpretation of app and messaging data.

Conducting forensic imaging, recovery and analysis in line with industry best practice.

Developing methodologies for cloud and hybrid ecosystems, including Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, AWS, Azure, and other SaaS or collaboration platforms.
•
Integrating automation, analytics, and AI-assisted techniques to enhance accuracy, speed and defensibility.
•
Mentoring and supporting junior team members, fostering a culture of excellence, curiosity and integrity.
•
Collaborating across FTI’s EMEA and global networks to share knowledge, develop tools and contribute to cross-disciplinary innovation.

Travelling as required to perform work at client premises in the UK and internationally, sometimes at short notice.

You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.

•
Experience conducting digital forensic investigations within consulting, law enforcement or corporate environments.
•
Drafting and peer review of digital forensics reports and expert reports for legal proceedings.

Experience of regulatory investigations, with a sound understanding of regulator expectations, evidential requirements and disclosure processes.

Expertise in mobile device forensics, including logical and physical extractions, artefact interpretation, and encrypted data handling.

Strong knowledge of forensic tools and methodologies (e.g. EnCase, X-Ways, Nuix, Magnet AXIOM, Cellebrite, Oxygen, FTK).

Experience leading forensic collections both on-site and remotely across the UK and internationally.

High degree of professionalism, discretion, and resilience in high-pressure environments.

Competence with scripting or automation languages (e.g. PowerShell, Python, SQL) for forensic workflow optimisation.

Exposure to AI and machine learning applications in forensic and eDiscovery contexts (e.g. triage, clustering, anomaly detection, generative summarisation).

Experience integrating forensic outputs within wider eDiscovery, incident response or regulatory frameworks.

Professional certifications such as EnCE, GASF, GCFA, CISSP, RCA, or equivalent.

As an EC&I Design Engineer, you will be responsible for delivering assigned project tasks, conducting technical research, and producing high-quality engineering reports. You will utilise your technical knowledge to develop and interpret engineering drawings, data, and documentation in support of the design, installation, testing, commissioning, maintenance, fault diagnosis, overhaul, and decommissioning of electrical and data systems within engineering infrastructure projects.
Your responsibilities will encompass a wide range of engineering systems, including:
• Low Voltage (LV) Distribution Systems
• Extra Low Voltage (ELV) Systems
• Control and Automation Systems
• Instrumentation and Monitoring Systems
• Sensors and Transmitters
• Auxiliary Electrical Systems
Duties will include:
• Provide technical expertise and guidance on Electrical, Control, and Instrumentation (EC&I) systems to support the wider design team.
• Develop, review, and interpret electrical and instrumentation design documentation, including:
• Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)
• Block Cable Diagrams
• Instrument Loop Diagrams
• Hook-Up Drawings
• Equipment Layouts
• General Arrangement (GA) Drawings
• Perform electrical design calculations and produce supporting documentation, including cable sizing and fault level calculations using AMTECH ProDesign and lighting calculations using DIALux.
• Carry out instrumentation design calculations and system assessments.
• Prepare and maintain comprehensive Electrical and Instrumentation design dossiers and technical documentation packages.
• Review project requirements and deliver assigned engineering tasks in accordance with project schedules, budgets, and quality standards.
• Undertake technical research, site surveys, and engineering assessments to support project development and delivery.
• Ensure compliance with company procedures, industry regulations, and health, safety, and environmental requirements.
• Participate in HAZOP studies, design reviews, risk assessments, and other process safety activities.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, design quality assurance, and project risk management processes.

• IET BS 7671 18th Edition qualification.
• Minimum of 3 years' experience in a relevant engineering or design role.

• Understanding of engineering research methods and technical report writing.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

• Professional, self-motivated, and committed to continuous learning and development.
